terminal.shell.description: The program a new terminal runs when terminal.defaultProfile names no profile: a name or path, or an argv. Empty: PowerShell 7, else Windows PowerShell, else cmd.

terminal.defaultProfile.description: The terminal profile New Terminal runs, by its id (pwsh, powershell, cmd, gitbash, python, ...; New Terminal's menu lists them and sets this). Empty: terminal.shell's program when it is set, else PowerShell 7, Windows PowerShell or the Command Prompt, the first there is.
